name: Targa Exploration Corp.
summary: Targa Exploration Corp. is a Canadian enterprise dedicated to identifying, exploring, and advancing mineral properties. The company possesses an agreement to secure complete ownership of the Shanghai property, a site comprising 150 Quartz claims spanning 2,600 hectares in the Mayo mining district of the Yukon territory. Founded in 2017, the firm changed its name from RCM Minerals Ltd. to Targa Exploration Corp. in July 2021 and maintains its principal office in Vancouver, Canada.
